d: India's smartphone market is facing a sharp slowdown just as the festive shopping season gets underway. Smartphone shipments fell 26% year-on-year to 35.8 million units in July-September 2026, the lowest third-quarter figure since 2016, according to Omdia. Rising memory chip costs, higher phone prices and cautious consumer spending are putting pressure on brands. Samsung has reclaimed the top spot, while Vivo, Oppo and Xiaomi have suffered shipment declines. Palki Sharma examines the numbers, the reasons behind the slowdown and what lies ahead for India's smartphone market.
